facts.what: Ethan 搂着 Sarah 闭眼松了口气——Styx 对 Johnny 是好的，他终于能呼吸了。
facts.anchor: Holding Sarah close to me, my eyes slid shut in relief. Styx is good for Johnny.

facts.what: 五个寄养孩子全在车祸中头部受伤，但 Weathers 夫妇不能带他们看医生或进急诊，否则当局介入会把他们拆散送走。
facts.anchor: with five foster children who all sustained head injuries without authorities being involved

facts.what: Dale 和 Harmony 跑腿买回共享车替代品——旧得多的红色吉普（金属车身、带防滚杠，像七十年代的 Tonka 玩具），Ethan 给它起名 Indestructible Tonka。
facts.anchor: But for the lovable foster parents who refused to give up on us, I numbly named it: “Indestructible Tonka.”

facts.what: 深夜查房时 Sebastian 睡梦中手臂垂在床外、手指伸展似要抓什么；Ethan 关门离开时听见他咕哝出 Zero-four-nine-nine。
facts.anchor: As I shut the door, he mumbled, “Zero-four-nine-nine.” Huh?

facts.what: Sarah 抚摸 Ethan 烧伤的脸，说他永远无法让她相信妹妹的死是他的错；Ethan 没有放火，却一直把妹妹的死归为己罪。
facts.anchor: You will never convince me her death is your fault.

facts.what: Sarah 一直拨打 Johnny 的电话，但号码已注销（disconnected）；她说能感觉到 Johnny 想打电话回家。
facts.anchor: She shrugged, and her voice failed her. “Even though the number is disconnected.”

facts.what: Sarah 坦言已爱了 Ethan 很久、说她不再年幼，随即猛地把嘴唇压到 Ethan 嘴上。
facts.anchor: Sarah growled, “I’m not too young anymore,” before slamming her lips to mine.

facts.what: Sarah 咬向 Ethan 脖子后，五个人全都捂着嘴、口齿不清地同喊 Mad G! Mad G!——嘴部剧痛在血誓相连的五人间同步。
facts.anchor: our mouths were aching like a sonofabitch, but only managed to yell, “Mad G! Mad G!”
